evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3530164 ($49.00, product W, in_person) scores 0.10 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.40.
Card baseline from 980 earlier transactions: median $67.91, 95th percentile $425.08; the flagged amount is 0.7x the median.
Billing region 330 is among the 53 regions in this card's history.
Cardholder C08623 reported the $49.00 charge as not theirs (case pack trigger, 2016-12-10 15:01:21).
Simulated customer validation: Cardholder recognises the purchase once shown the merchant, amount and device/location details and withdraws the dispute.
Policy R3: Customer confirms the transaction: CLOSE_NO_FRAUD, with the confirmation noted in the case file.

Policy §3a: A case is opened at probability 0.30, on any evidence request, or on any dispute; a report is filed only when fraud is confirmed or strongly suspected and exposure exceeds $1,000, the activity connects to a shared device, region or another customer's fraud, or the pattern is coordinated or undocumented.

case.summary: Alert on transaction 3530164 ($49.00) on card C08623-K2. The graph evidence does not support fraud: the transaction is consistent with the holder's own history, and the calibrated model puts it at 0.02. Cardholder recognises the purchase once shown the merchant, amount and device/location details and withdraws the dispute. Closed as legitimate; no report.
